name: Agreeing & Disagreeing Politely
equipment: A notebook and a colleague or mirror to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on agreeing & disagreeing politely -- practice these key phrases out loud:
That's a fair point, I agree.
I see it a bit differently -- can I offer another perspective?
I'm not sure I fully agree, mainly because of the timeline.
That makes sense, though I'd add one consideration.
Try using at least two of these phrases in a short role-play scenario at work.
